The presence of hair follicles and the lack of significant atypia or irregular pigmentation suggest it is not a Melanoma (MEL) or Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC). Actinic Keratosis (AKIEC) can also be considered due to the rough texture, but the overall appearance is more consistent with a Nevus. agent conservative fusion: evidence was not strong enough to override the baseline diagnosis, so the baseline label was preserved.
